failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1: 'Missing evidence documents needed: 1. Information about "You Can't See Me" (the MTV show) - specifically who hosted it and when it aired'. Subsequent query (hop 3): 'Who hosted the MTV show "You Can't See Me" and were they a member of Likwit Crew...?' Despite the well-formed query targeting the missing MTV show, no passage about 'You Can't See Me' (the show) appeared in any retrieval hop. Only other MTV shows were retrieved (America's Best Dance Crew, Yo! MTV Raps, Why Can't I Be You?, etc.).

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query hop 2 (paraphrased, query text not shown but can be inferred from retrieval results): targeted general MTV shows and personalities. Query hop 3: 'Who hosted the MTV show "You Can't See Me" and were they a member of Likwit Crew or the same band/crew that Defari was part of?' Both hops 2 and 3 returned largely overlapping documents about MTV dance competition shows (Quest Crew, Layla Kayleigh hosting America's Best Dance Crew, Beat Freaks, Fanny Pak, etc.) and generic MTV content, failing to advance toward the specific missing evidence about 'You Can't See Me' as a show title.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 analyzes passages about 'Why Can't I Be You?' (hosted by Nick Zano with Locksley theme song), 'If You Really Knew Me', 'You Wrote It You Watch It' (Jon Stewart), and 'You Can't Do That On Television' (Teddy Wilson) at length, noting 'The closest match is "You Can't Do That On Television," but this is a different show and is not described as MTV.' These passages are clearly irrelevant—none involve Likwit Crew members or a show titled 'You Can't See Me'—yet the solver devoted substantial reasoning to explaining why each does not match.
